package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const relationAccessQueryParam = "via_relation_id"

func publicContentContext(request *http.Request) (context.Context, error) {
	relationID := strings.TrimSpace(request.URL.Query().Get(relationAccessQueryParam))
	if relationID != "" {
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(relationID); err != nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	userID, role, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrForbidden
	}
	return answeruc.WithPublicContentAccessAudience(request.Context(), relationID, userID, role), nil
}
